REVIEW_PERIOD.FORM_HELP: Complete the sections below. You can save an incomplete Draft and finish it later. Preview the configuration before publishing.
REVIEW_PERIOD.READ_ONLY_HELP: These are the saved settings for this annual period. Historical settings are not replaced by current Role defaults.
REVIEW_PERIOD.EMPTY: No review periods yet. Create a review period to get started.
REVIEW_PERIOD.NO_MATCH: No review periods match these filters.
REVIEW_PERIOD.LOAD_ERROR: Could not load the review period. Please try again.
REVIEW_PERIOD.SAVE_ERROR: Could not save these settings. Please try again.
REVIEW_PERIOD.DELETE_ERROR: Could not delete this review period. Please refresh and try again.
REVIEW_PERIOD.API_ERROR_HELP: Your entries are still available. Review the message above, correct the settings or return to the list to refresh the period status.
REVIEW_PERIOD.DELETE_DETAIL: Delete "{{name}}" and its configuration? This action cannot be undone. The server will check whether deletion is still allowed.
REVIEW_PERIOD.PREVIEW_HELP: Review the settings and generated schedule below. Preview does not save changes. Publish saves a Draft and schedules opening on its Start Date, or opens it immediately if that date has been reached.
REVIEW_PERIOD.BASIC_HELP: Set the annual performance measurement dates.
REVIEW_PERIOD.PERIOD_END_HELP: End Date is the performance measurement cut-off, not an automatic closure date. Final assessments may be due after it.
REVIEW_PERIOD.DEFAULTS_HELP: Choose a Start Date to load previous weightages, Department schedules and annual consolidation where available. Check these settings before publishing.
REVIEW_PERIOD.COPIED_DEFAULTS: Previous weightages and each Role's latest saved frequency have been loaded. These are independent settings for this new period.
REVIEW_PERIOD.COPIED_DEFAULTS_FROM: Settings copied from {{period}}. Changes here will not affect that period.
REVIEW_PERIOD.INITIAL_DEFAULTS: Available defaults have been loaded. Choose each participating Department's schedule before publishing.
REVIEW_PERIOD.DEFAULTS_CHANGED_DATE: Your edited settings have been kept. You can reload the latest published settings if needed.
REVIEW_PERIOD.RELOAD_DEFAULTS_DETAIL: This reload replaces Employee-Level weightages and legacy Role frequencies. Selected Roles, chosen Department schedules and your explicit annual consolidation choice are kept.
REVIEW_PERIOD.ROLES_HELP: Select the Job Roles covered by this annual period. Monthly, Quarterly and Annually are checkpoints within the same period, not separate periods.
REVIEW_PERIOD.CLASSIFY_ROLE: Assign an Employee Level in Role management before publishing.
REVIEW_PERIOD.LEVELS_HELP: Each Employee Level has its own KPI split. Company + Department + Individual must equal 100% in every row. These settings apply only to this annual period.
REVIEW_PERIOD.COMPOSITION_HELP: This separate split combines KPI Performance and Attitude Evaluation into the final appraisal score. Together they must total 100%.
REVIEW_PERIOD.CONSOLIDATION_HELP: Use the final checkpoint score or average all checkpoint scores. All required results must be completed.

DEPARTMENT_SCHEDULE.HELP: Choose how often each Department reviews its KPIs. Employees' Individual KPI assessments follow the same schedule. Company KPI results are recorded monthly.
DEPARTMENT_SCHEDULE.ROLES_HELP: Select participating Job Roles. Employee Level determines KPI weight allocation; the Department schedule determines assessment frequency.
DEPARTMENT_SCHEDULE.SELECT_ROLES: Select participating Roles above to configure their Departments.
DEPARTMENT_SCHEDULE.FROZEN: This published Department schedule, period dates and KPI deadline offsets are fixed. Organisational changes will not alter it.
DEPARTMENT_SCHEDULE.COMPANY_MONTHLY: Record Company progress to date against annual targets each month. Quarterly reviews use the result for their final month.
DEPARTMENT_SCHEDULE.LEVEL_HELP: Configure an Employee Level for each Role below, then refresh configuration. Your unsaved period settings will be kept. You can save a Draft now; publication requires these mappings.
DEPARTMENT_SCHEDULE.CONFIGURE_LEVEL: Configure Employee Level (opens a new tab)
DEPARTMENT_SCHEDULE.CONTACT_ADMIN: Ask a Role administrator to configure these Employee Levels, then refresh configuration.
DEPARTMENT_SCHEDULE.ROLE_UNAVAILABLE: This Role is unavailable or you do not have permission to edit it. Return to Review Period Setup and refresh configuration.
DEPARTMENT_SCHEDULE.LEGACY_DRAFT: This Draft still uses Role-based frequencies. To adopt Department schedules, explicitly update its configuration below.
DEPARTMENT_SCHEDULE.ADOPT_HELP: This changes only this Draft to Department-based scheduling and central results. Choose Monthly or Quarterly for every participating Department. Existing Role frequencies will not be copied.

REVIEW_PERIOD.SETUP_HELP: Set the date by which Company, Department and Individual KPI setup, including required submission, review and approval, should be completed. This date must be on or before the Start Date.
REVIEW_PERIOD.ASSESSMENT_HELP: Set how many days employees and Superiors have to complete each KPI review. Preview shows the resulting deadlines.
REVIEW_PERIOD.DAYS_AFTER_CHECKPOINT: calendar days after the review checkpoint ends
REVIEW_PERIOD.DAYS_AFTER_SELF: calendar days after the Self-Assessment deadline
REVIEW_PERIOD.ATTITUDE_HELP: Set the opening date and deadlines for the annual Attitude Evaluation.
REVIEW_PERIOD.APPRAISAL_HELP: Allow time for all required KPI results and the Attitude Evaluation to be completed before appraisal submission.
REVIEW_PERIOD.ATTITUDE_OPENING_HELP: Employees can start their annual Attitude Self-Assessment from this date.

SCHEDULE_FIELD_HELP.selfAssessmentDaysAfterCheckpoint: Calendar days after the KPI checkpoint end date shown in Preview.
SCHEDULE_FIELD_HELP.superiorAssessmentDaysAfterSelfDeadline: Calendar days after the employee's KPI Self-Assessment deadline.
SCHEDULE_FIELD_HELP.attitudeSelfAssessmentDeadline: Target date for employees to submit their Attitude Self-Assessment.
SCHEDULE_FIELD_HELP.superiorAttitudeEvaluationDeadline: Target date for Superiors to review submitted Attitude Self-Assessments.
SCHEDULE_FIELD_HELP.appraisalRecommendationDeadline: Target date for Superiors to submit completed appraisal recommendations to HR.
SCHEDULE_FIELD_HELP.hrFinalisationDeadline: Target date for HR to review and finalise submitted appraisals.

DEADLINE_GUIDE.TITLE: Deadline Guide
DEADLINE_GUIDE.RESULTS_COMPLETE: All required KPI and Attitude results complete
DEADLINE_GUIDE.TARGET_DATES: KPI and Attitude schedules run separately. Appraisals can be submitted once all required results are complete. Deadlines are target dates; late submissions and reviews remain allowed while the Review Period is Open.

REVIEW_PERIOD.SCHEDULE_HELP: Generated by the server from the selected frequencies and day offsets. Roles with the same frequency share this schedule.
REVIEW_PERIOD.NO_SCHEDULE: No checkpoint schedule has been generated for this Draft. Complete the configuration and use Preview to check the dates.
